src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2022_us_cd118_500k
cd.vint: The Census Bureau's lines of the 118th Congress's districts (its file says session 118).
rec: Court-adopted congressional plan: the Legislature's HB 52 and SB 200 were both vetoed on May 27, 2022, and the New Hampshire Supreme Court (Norelli v. Secretary of State, No. 2022-0184) adopted a 'least change' plan drawn by its special master on May 31, 2022; 2 districts
NH General Court docket HB 52 (2022), 'apportioning congressional districts': vetoed 05/27/2022; veto sustained 09/15/2022

The Legislature's vetoes (gc.nh.gov dockets, opened) prove no statute set 2022's lines, and RSA 662:1 still prints the 2012 districts; the court order itself is reported by Loyola (secondary) and was not opened because courts.nh.gov refuses scripts. File check: the cb_2022 cd118 file's District 1 is 5,551.9 sq km, which is not the 2012 plan's 6,384.3 sq km and not the vetoed HB 52 plan's 5,281.9 sq km (computed from its text), so the file holds a third plan, consistent with the court's (SB 200's final text was not compared). Equals the 2024 file.

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2022_us_sldu_500k
sldu.vint: The Census Bureau's 2022 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2022 legislative session year.
rec: 2022 plan: SB 240, Chapter 45 of the Laws of 2022 (RSA 662:3), signed May 6, 2022; 24 districts
NH General Court docket SB 240 (2022), 'apportioning state senate districts': signed 05/06/2022; Chapter 45
Census cb_2022 sldu file: LSY 2022; 18 of 24 areas differ from the 2020 file by more than 0.5 percent (up to 70 percent); equals the 2024 file.

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2022_us_sldl_500k
sldl.vint: The Census Bureau's 2022 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2022 legislative session year.
rec: 2022 plan: HB 50, Chapter 9 of the Laws of 2022 (RSA 662:5), signed Mar. 23, 2022; 203 numbered districts in the statute
NH General Court docket HB 50 (2022), 'apportioning state representative districts': signed 03/23/2022; Chapter 9

Census cb_2022 sldl file: LSY 2022, 164 districts named 'Belknap 01' and so on; 154 of 157 districts in both files differ from the 2020 file by more than 0.5 percent. The statute lists 203 districts and the Census draws 164: the other 39 (for example Belknap 8, Belmont-Sanbornton-Tilton, which repeats towns already in Belknap 3 and 4) are floterial districts that overlay other districts and are not in the file, so contests in them cannot be tied to a shape.
